# New Level Design Studio

New Level Design Studio (NLDS) is a founder-led design studio based in Port Orange, Florida. It builds premium websites, brand direction, and ongoing website care for local businesses across Volusia County and Central Florida.

## Business

- Name: New Level Design Studio
- Short name: NLDS
- Founder: Michael Vail
- Location: Port Orange, Florida 32127
- Phone: (386) 846-5754
- Email: michael@newlvlstudio.com
- Website: https://newlvlstudio.com
- Positioning: Websites, brand direction, and ongoing website care for local businesses ready to look credible, get found, and turn attention into real customer inquiries.

## Service Area

- Port Orange, FL (primary)
- Daytona Beach, FL
- Ormond Beach, FL
- New Smyrna Beach, FL
- Volusia County, FL
- Central Florida

## Services

- Website Design: Custom-coded, mobile-first websites structured for local businesses — clear offer, fast load, direct inquiry paths.
- Website Redesign: A structured rebuild for an existing site that no longer represents the business.
- Brand Direction: Logo systems, branded graphics, and web imagery for consistent presence across website, Google Business Profile, and social platforms.
- Website Copy & Visual Support: Branded graphics, launch assets, and supporting content that support local visibility.
- Website Care: Ongoing maintenance — content updates, link checks, image swaps, monthly review. Starting at $99/month.

## Pricing (starting points — final pricing depends on scope)

- Starter Website: from $499
- Core Website: from $899 (local SEO-friendly structure included)
- Pro Website: from $1,499 (full SEO-ready structure, schema markup)
- Visual Starter Pack (direct link only, not part of the core service hierarchy): from $129
- Ongoing Website Support: from $99/month
- Add-ons available: extra pages, landing pages, SEO setup, copywriting upgrades, video packages
